properties.description: Build the Port 101 catalog foundation: a `service` blueprint plus six mock service entities. Use when the user asks to set up a Port catalog, create a service blueprint, load sample/mock data, or start a Port POC catalog from scratch.
properties.instructions:
# Catalog foundations

Your job is to create the `service` blueprint and load six mock service entities.

## Steps

1. Upsert a blueprint identified `service` with properties: `description` (markdown), `language` (enum: Go, Python, Node.js, Java, TypeScript), `lifecycle` (enum: Production, Staging, Experimental), `tier` (enum: Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), `on_call` (string), `has_readme` (boolean), `repo_url` (string, format url).
2. Upsert these six entities on blueprint `service` (identifier / language / lifecycle / tier / on_call / has_readme):
   - `checkout-service` / Go / Production / Tier 1 / checkout-team / true
   - `auth-service` / Java / Production / Tier 1 / identity-team / true
   - `notifications-service` / Node.js / Staging / Tier 2 / platform-team / true
   - `billing-service` / Python / Production / Tier 1 / (empty) / false
   - `search-service` / TypeScript / Staging / Tier 2 / (empty) / false
   - `inventory-service` / Python / Experimental / Tier 3 / (empty) / false

Report back which blueprint and entities were created or already existed.
